title: Young musicians have not heard real big bands
summary: Albert says young players never heard good big bands, that his own band stopped in 1940 for lack of work, and that big bands now imitate the young.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Do you think the musicians are a hack of the play of that kind of music?

What kind of music are we talking about? The ones that play? No, maybe the young ones, that's all they know. The thing about it is this, that these young musicians have never been exposed to real good bands. Big bands. Big bands. Big bands started this band in 1940 because of the depression that was almost coming back. And they weren't in demand. So, take my band for instance, I stopped in 1940 because there wasn't too much money, there wasn't too many dates, and things like that. But these young musicians never heard these things. So, they don't know.
Yeah, well the only time they hear is a few seconds on television. That's all.
And that's all very seldom. Well even the big bands today are out in left field. They're trying to do things like the young musicians are doing.
